game.replay.action-log.deterministic: The fixed native journey records 228 ordered actions with before/after state digests; this proves the exact scripted journey, not every possible player journey.
game.replay.engine-byte-lineage: The replay binds the exact normalized bytes of the reviewed native engine entrypoint; uploads and generated runtimes remain out of scope.
game.replay.state-checkpoints.byte-bound: Forty selected checkpoints bind action index, action digest, state digest, zone, and player coordinate; the complete action chain remains separately retained.

game.trailer.replay-state-renderer: The renderer reconstructs exact deterministic engine states; it is not browser capture or live player input.
game.trailer.player-motion.visible: All forty gameplay frames render the checkpoint player coordinate and a bounded movement trace checked against expected pixels.
game.trailer.five-zone-state-evidence: The plan and frame lineage include all five game zones, with eight checkpoints selected per gameplay scene.

game.replay.fixed-trusted-entrypoint: Only the exact reviewed Four Roots native engine entrypoint was executed under Mike's explicit try-it direction; no general executor was added.
game.replay.no-provider-network-children: The replay and planner declare and measure zero provider calls, network requests, and child processes; media encoding remains the separately reviewed Asset Hands path.
game.trailer.publication-rights-hold: Public distribution remains HOLD; install, publish, promotion, merge, and CANON authority remain false.

video.container.structure.verify: Asset Hands and the game package selftest parsed the actual MP4 and WebM structures.
video.first-middle-last.decode: The pinned native media runtime decoded the first, middle, and last proof frames; selected PNGs were also inspected visually.
video.browser.playback.observe: The local WebM played for repeated observations in the in-app Chromium surface at desktop and narrow widths with captions active and no console or media errors.
game.trailer.replay-scene.visual-compare: Tests compare every gameplay frame's rendered player-marker pixels with the checkpoint coordinates; live browser sampling separately observed changing map scenes.
